[[Andorra]] competed at the [[2014 Winter Olympics]] in [[Sochi]], [[Russia]], from 7 to 23 February 2014. The Andorran team consisted of six athletes in three sports.<ref name="a">{{cite web |url=http://www.coa.ad/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=340:delegacio-dels-jocs-olimpics-de-sochi&catid=118:sochi-2014&Itemid=64|trans-title=We present the Andorran delegation that will represent our state at the Olympics in Sochi. |language=ca |title=Delegació dels Jocs Olímpics de Sochi |date=24 January 2014 |website=www.coa.ad |publisher=[[Comitè Olímpic Andorrà]] |access-date=24 January 2014}}</ref>

== Alpine skiing ==
{{main|Alpine skiing at the 2014 Winter Olympics}}
According to the final quota allocation released on 20 January 2014, Andorra had five athletes in qualification position.<ref name="quota">{{cite web |url=https://data.fis-ski.com/media/olympic-games/quota-20-01-2014-6.pdf |title=Summary of Quota allocation as per 20.01.2014 |date=20 January 2014 |website=www.fis-ski.com |publisher=[[International Ski Federation|FIS]] |access-date=20 January 2014}}</ref> The final team was announced with four athletes, meaning the country decided to reject one of its quota spots.<ref name="a"/>

== Biathlon  ==
{{main|Biathlon at the 2014 Winter Olympics}}
Reallocation of quotas, allowed Andorra to enter one female athlete. [[Laure Soulie]] was officially announced as a member of the team on 24 January 2014.<ref name="a"/>

== Snowboarding ==
{{main|Snowboarding at the 2014 Winter Olympics}}
According to the final quota allocation released on 20 January 2014, Andorra had one athlete in qualification position.<ref name="quota"/> The final team was announced on 24 January 2014.<ref name="a"/> Tarroch was disqualified in the round of 39, and thus finished a joint 25th.<ref>{{cite news |last=Basu |first=Anand |date=18 February 2014 |title=Olympics-Snowboarding-Men's cross finals result |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/olympics-snowboarding-men-cross-final-idUSL3N0LM1UO20140218 |newspaper=[[Reuters]] |access-date=20 February 2014 }}</ref>

==Non-qualified sports==
=== Cross-country skiing ===
{{main|Cross-country skiing at the 2014 Winter Olympics}}
According to the quota allocation released on 20 January 2014, Andorra had one athlete in qualification position.<ref name="quota"/> However the final team did not include the qualified athlete, [[Irineu Esteve Altimiras]].<ref name="a"/>
